global.override: explicit human voice command always wins

DIVERGE.judgment: park concerns as risk cards in Parking lot

DEEPEN.exit: key questions answered or tagged assumption

transition_rule: propose; yes or 5s no objection = go; 'not yet' = +3min (max 2)

HMW.trigger: session start OR debate about the problem
steps: What problem are we solving today?
Three framings on screen. Which fits?
HMW.canvas: top banner + 2-3 grey alternatives + constraints zone

steps: Mapping around the HMW. Shout branches.

affinity_kj.trigger: >=20 ungrouped cards OR end of diverge
steps: I grouped {n} cards into {k} themes. Check them?
affinity_kj.canvas: colored zones, bold titles, Unsorted zone, stacked duplicates

scamper.trigger: voice request OR one idea dominates builds OR novelty<0.25

six_hats.trigger: polarized debate OR candidate to examine
steps: Everyone wears the same hat. White: facts only.
Blue: so, what do we decide?
six_hats.background_mode: silent checklist, popup when a hat is empty

steps: Flip it: how do we guarantee failure?
Invert the top three into fixes.
That feels like a root cause. Agree?

oral_brainwriting.trigger: overlaps OR group>4 OR few speakers
steps: Silent round. Grab paper. Three ideas, three minutes.
Read your top two, one by one.
oral_brainwriting.canvas: round column, burst cards, dedupe stack

steps: Questions only, no answers. Who uses #{n}?
Which questions can I research now?
Quick round. One idea each, pass allowed.

worst_idea.trigger: silence>30s OR cautious tone OR warm-up
steps: Let's go terrible. Worst idea for our HMW?

analogies.trigger: novelty<0.25 OR one cluster>50% OR 'inspire us'

first_principles.trigger: 'everyone does it this way' OR fixed constraints
steps: What do we know is truly true?
From the truths only, what's possible?
It's one year later. #{n} failed. Why?

dot_voting_voice.trigger: >=8 clustered ideas OR consensus_lex>=2 OR timebox
dot_voting_voice.rule: never reveal AI ranking before human vote

impact_effort.canvas: 2x2 quick wins / big bets / fill-ins / money pits

disney.trigger: single concept to develop OR dreamers vs critics

steps: Eight themes around the HMW. Go.

challenge_rules.diverge_behavior: park as risk card: 'Parking that concern. Idea first?'
examples: What are we assuming must be true for #{n}?
Devil's advocate: what if nobody pays?
We agreed in two minutes. What are we missing?
So what would make #{n} survive that?

blind_spots.diverge_policy: queue results, show in DEEPEN unless major invalidation
blind_spots.prompt_when: >=3 empty dimensions after 10min OR entering DEEPEN (1 voice prompt max)

_sources: Diehl&Stroebe 1987; IDEO 7 rules; Wadinambiarachchi CHI24 (AI fixation); Doshi&Hauser SciAdv24; Lee CHI25 LBW (devil's advocate); Alsobay 2025 arXiv 2508.08242; Do CSCW23 (repair); Liu CHI25 Inner Thoughts. Numeric thresholds are design heuristics, calibrate in testing.
